supersedes: f9b2557 adapter semantics; observed_channel_mask mapping was invalid

compatibility.adapter_policy: producer fields are never renamed in place; all aliases are explicit adapter mappings

latent_state.name: z_analysis
latent_state.source: Agent1 frozen assimilation output or a separately labelled FEM oracle upper bound
latent_state.uncertainty_policy: exactly one of std/covariance/ensemble; derived std is trigger-eligible only when calibrated; unavailable remains NaN

node_observation.forbidden_mapping: observed_channel_mask is latent assimilation attribution and must never create a node measurement
node_observation.missing_value_policy: missing values remain NaN at the contract boundary and are zero-filled only after normalization; the mask remains an input
node_observation.oracle_warning: Agent1 fem_raw_energy_upper_bound is synthetic FEM oracle evidence, not a real road observation

global_observation.mask_shape: same as values; boolean; read directly from Agent1 independent observation arrays

known_history.timestamp: Agent1 timestamp plus timestamp_mask; missing is empty plus mask=false
known_history.equivalent_load_index: Agent1 values plus mask; missing is NaN plus mask=false
known_history.delta_t: Agent1 values plus mask; available values are non-negative and positive after the first inspection
known_history.traffic: Agent2 axle spectrum, cumulative equivalent load, distance from last inspection, and load distribution after a frozen vectorizer, plus boolean mask
known_history.environment: Agent2 temperature and moisture series after a frozen vectorizer, plus boolean mask
known_history.maintenance: Agent2 typed maintenance history encoded by a frozen intervention vectorizer
known_history.maintenance_state_reset: requires maintenance_reset_declared, non-empty event id and a new state_segment_id
known_history.time_rule: FEM fatigue cycle is never relabelled as axle passage, ESAL, calendar time, inspection epoch, or road load block

future_scenario.traffic: scenario axle/load exposure after the same frozen vectorizer, plus boolean mask
future_scenario.environment: scenario temperature/moisture after the same frozen vectorizer, plus boolean mask
future_scenario.maintenance: typed future intervention; a non-zero plan requires a declared maintenance-effect model id
future_scenario.scenario_hash_rule: scenario id, delta_t, masks, maintenance values, and maintenance model id are hashed together

outputs.state_output_status: trained or tooling-only status is mandatory
outputs.hazard_probability: scenario-conditioned output only when the risk head is explicitly trained
outputs.cumulative_event_probability: derived from trained discrete hazard only
outputs.untrained_risk_policy: return unavailable_untrained with null tensors; never expose random heads

closed_loop: trained scenario-conditioned hazard/RUL or explicit unavailable
hard_rules: FEM eta0 remains the physical numerical reference
synthetic and real observations never share an unlabeled row
psi_raw, fatigue history, degradation, and active driver are not direct road measurements
cycle index, cycle/89, future failure cycle, and repeated windows as pseudo-road samples are forbidden
all compared models receive identical analysis hash, observed origin, mask, scenario hash, seeds, and budgets
field prediction beyond h3 is not available from unlimited deterministic recursion
missing uncertainty and untrained risk heads are reported unavailable
decision_eligible=false evidence cannot produce an operational request or stop
system maintenance and inspection-overdue safety gates remain independent of packet eligibility
